Create ONE new high-quality pixel-art environment variation for the Sproto Fighter 2D fighting game. Use the supplied CURRENT STAGE image as the visual reference: preserve its recognizable zone identity and arcade pixel-art craftsmanship, while creating a distinctly new location, palette, atmosphere and scenic composition. Zone: muddy industrial undercity, brick drains, battered corrugated metal and pipes. This variation is "Copper Dawn": peach sunrise, pale teal mist; a riverside pumping quay with brick sluices. Do not simply recolor or duplicate the reference; make a fresh background location within the same world.
Production composition requirements: full seamless 16:9 side-view arena, fixed camera at fighter height, NO isometric camera. The combat floor is a single continuous flat horizontal walkable surface across the entire image, with its foot-contact line exactly 80.3 percent down the canvas (y=578 on a 1280x720 display). Empty low-contrast foreground below that line. Keep the full fighter lane x=4% to96%, y=45% to84% clear of occluding pillars, people, fences or foreground props. Put architectural landmarks and scenic details BEHIND the fighters and above the foot line. Level left and right corners, no broken platforms, stairs, cliffs, pits or water in the combat lane. Keep the upper 22% visually calm for HUD readability. Rich background depth, deliberate crisp stepped pixel clusters, strong material shading, coherent lighting and restrained high quality 1990s arcade pixel-art texture. Environment ONLY: NO characters, people, animals, enemies, silhouettes, text, words, logos, UI, borders, panels, photorealism, painterly blur or watermarks.
